entity: SVB Financial Group and subsidiaries, consolidated

10k.locator: Consolidated Balance Sheets; Note 22 Regulatory Matters; fair value disclosures

march8.role: outcome comparison and explicitly conditioned sale replay only

fed_evolution.locator: SVBFG balance-sheet growth, uninsured funding, HTM duration and SVB failure
fed_evolution.role: retrospective source; 94% uninsured and 6.2-year duration describe year-end exposures, not independently calibrated behavioral parameters

dfpi.locator: possession order: March 9 withdrawals and closing cash
dfpi.role: held-out cash outcome; withdrawals also used in separately labeled conditional replay

fed_regulation.role: retrospective regulatory context, not simulation calibration

observed_event.march10_status: expected/requested, not completed withdrawals; bank closed that morning

assumptions.afs_duration_basis: illustrative aggregate sensitivity, not a fitted security tape or use of the later sold-subset duration
assumptions.behavioral_calibration: none; stress sensitivities only, no estimated run probability
assumptions.interest_and_operations: zeroed to isolate liquidity and mark mechanics; no Jan-March NII, principal runoff, origination, deposit trend, hedge or fee forecast
assumptions.opening_net_loans: frozen net carrying value; gross loan and allowance retained as source facts, not credit/CECL modeling
assumptions.other_assets: fixed-value ledger placeholders, not priced securities
assumptions.event_calendar: day 0 = March 6 proxy, day 2 = March 8 sale, day 3 = March 9 withdrawals, day 4 = March 10 requested outflows; December 31 balances held unchanged until these events
assumptions.sale_size_interpretation: USD 21bn treated as cash proceeds in proxy; disclosure rounded and security-level proceeds/costs unavailable
assumptions.sale_cost_allocation: pro-rata year-end AFS cost and fair value; actual sold subset unavailable
assumptions.tax_sensitivity_basis: March 8 Q1 guidance, retrospective comparison only; no immediate tax-refund liquidity assumed
assumptions.htm_funding: none in base; optional capacity/lag counterfactuals assume sufficient eligible unencumbered HTM with 5% haircut, not historical access
assumptions.regulatory_ratios: native treasury calculations use disclosed eligible capital and aggregate RWA; no bottom-up RWA or eligibility validation; daily ledger ratios are proxies and not reported as SVB capital
